description: Semantic Scholar cited-by lookup: list the papers that CITE a given paper (the works citing it), with their titles, authors, year, and citation counts. Use for "cited-by papers", "who cites this paper", "papers that cite X", forward citation tracing, and finding follow-up work. Keyless.

limit.description: Max citing papers to return (default 10, max 25).

paper_id.description: Paper identifier. A Semantic Scholar ID, or prefixed: "DOI:10...", "arXiv:2106.15928", "CorpusId:...".

name: get_paper_citations
title: Get Paper Citations
